purpose: Audit trail for TikTok and social-discovery candidates added to Korea Spot Scout.

method.discoveryRule: TikTok and other public social results identify a candidate; they do not verify practical facts.
method.cardRule: A finished swipe card needs a stable identity, no duplicate in the current deck, and at least one official or primary source confirming the place and current practical details.
method.timeSensitiveRule: Expired pop-ups stay rejected. Permanent pop-up hubs may be accepted but must be rechecked shortly before the 2027 trip.
method.scoreRule: Only accepted candidates receive confidence and scout status in the swipe deck.

limitations: TikTok blocks systematic crawling, so coverage is not exhaustive.
TikTok search links and indexed channel pages are stored as discovery mentions, not factual authorities.
Hours, prices, closures, trail conditions and active pop-ups must be rechecked near the travel date.
